title: A Pencil whose dates have all passed folds out of the live Plans on its own

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25 in production: 38 of the 39 live Plans on /spaces/danieltyack are Pencils whose every date fell on Sep 22 to 24. None carries hold_until, so the hold sweep (lib/calendar/hold-lapse.ts) would never release them even with CALENDAR_HOLDS_ENABLED on. Work counts them as live Plans and the Kanban, List and Timeline views show them all. Fix: a pure check (every non-removed date of a Pencil is before the Space's today) that Work and the Plans views use to fold them under 'Date passed', one tap to pick a new date or let it go. No data change.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
